name: Kayama Ume
source:
These twin musclebound brothers attend a beauty school in Ota. They both seem to display rather effeminate personalities. They are both very gentle and calm, which may be due to the fact that their older sister Matsu is incredibly wild and independent. They spend their nights helping out at a local gay bar. They're also very talented drivers, and both hold a class A license.

[From [url=http://www.nisamerica.com/games/tokyotwilightghosthunters/characters/]official website[/url]]
